vet.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Vet
vet.description: A young woman of 18, a medieval scribe who reads Latin: sharp, sarcastic, precise, loves exact facts, quick dry wit, clear bright voice, a little shy with authorities. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Natural, close studio recording.

voice_design.text: Pesa unes quatre tones. I no l'ha tombat el vent. Ahir et va dir que una dona i un arbre no valen res. Avui ho sentirà d'un monjo. Jo no parlo amb jutges. Jo copio el que diuen.

narrator.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Narrador
narrator.description: A man in his sixties, narrator of a medieval mystery adventure with dry bureaucratic humour, like an old chronicler: warm, calm, wry and understated, mid-low voice, brisk pace, never slow. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Clean studio recording.

voice_design.text: Fa cent trenta anys, l'abadessa Emma va plantar un avet al costat del monestir. L'únic de la vall. El comte Bernat de Besalú deu una fortuna al monestir. I el comte té mala memòria per als deutes.

ponc.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Ponç
ponc.description: A middle-aged medieval judge, pedantic and fussy, obsessed with seals, witnesses and procedure, pompous but honest, nasal, precise and slightly self-important official voice. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Clean studio recording.

voice_design.text: Una dona i un arbre: dos testimonis sense valor. Tres testimonis i un segell, ja ho sabeu. Saig, a l'acta! Escrivà del comte: presenteu la meitat comtal de la carta de l'any vuit-cents vuitanta-set.

sunifred.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Sunifred
sunifred.description: A man around forty, a medieval count's scribe: gentle, extremely polite, soft-spoken and meticulous, humble and obliging, never raises his voice, quietly hiding something, smooth light voice. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Natural, close studio recording.

voice_design.text: En què us puc servir? Amb molt de gust, i amb tinta. Jo tinc les mans per a la ploma, senyor jutge. Un document segellat no es crema... s'arxiva... sempre s'arxiva...

ramon.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Ramon
ramon.description: A man of about fifty, a medieval woodcutter and father of two daughters: calm, a man of few words, gruff but tender, deep warm rough voice, slow and steady. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Natural, close studio recording.

voice_design.text: Primer aparta les branques. Després ja xerrarem. Mànec de boix i tres osques. És la meva marca. Aquest és el vi del batlle? Ara entenc per què no convida mai.

joanet.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Joanet
joanet.description: A man in his forties, a lazy, philosophical eel fisherman by the river: slow, drowsy, laid-back and amused, drawling relaxed voice, a bit raspy. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Natural, close studio recording.

voice_design.text: És una barca filosòfica: pensa en l'aigua, i l'aigua hi entra. Ferro, diu l'Ermessenda. Jo dic que una vaca. Ens hem jugat un ou. Aquella nit vaig veure un fanal a l'avet.

ermessenda.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Ermessenda
ermessenda.description: A woman of about fifty, a medieval miller: loud, energetic, quick-tempered and grumbling about the dry canal, but warm-hearted and generous, strong earthy voice. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Natural, close studio recording.

voice_design.text: Ni una gota! Tinc el blat del monestir a mig moldre i el rec sec. L'aigua torna al rec! Té, nous del meu noguer. Les clofolles, per tenyir, que són bones.

arnulf.name: Conjura de l'Avet · Arnulf
arnulf.description: An old medieval canon and copyist, around seventy: mild, meek and a bit absent-minded, thin soft trembling voice, gently self-deprecating. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Natural, close studio recording.

voice_design.text: Cada còpia amb errates diferents. Que es vegi que és feta a mà. Pregunteu-ho al germà Gombau, que sap més lletra que jo. Bé, això diu ell.
